item.title: Governments across Australia know how to stop violence against Indigenous women, they just don't do it
item.description: Indigenous women and children experience disproportionate levels of family violence. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander women are killed at rates up to six times higher than non-Indigenous women, overwhelmingly by intimate partners (76%) or family members. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Young Australians are staying in the family home for longer – and it’s not hard to see why
item.description: Housing costs are up with renters worst affected and financial stress is also growing, according to the largest survey of its type Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Every year, thousands of Australians answer a series of questions as part of the long-running Hilda survey. This questionnaire – more expansively known as the household, income and labour dynamics in Australia survey – has been tracking the same households since 2001. Patrick Commins is Guardian Australia’s economics editor Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Coogee ranks as Sydney’s worst ocean beach for faecal pollution – again
item.description: Seventy-nine per cent of all NSW swimming sites rated ‘good’ or ‘very good’, as state’s cleanest and most polluted beaches revealed Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Coogee has ranked as the Sydney ocean beach most polluted with faecal matter, an annual state survey has found. Of 245 swimming sites across New South Wales, 43 sites (17.6%) received a rating of “poor” or “very poor” in the 2026 State of the Beaches report , part of an annual survey by the state’s environment department. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.

item.title: Dolly Parton’s estate in feud with nephew over alleged threats
item.description: Bryan Seaver, who announced Parton’s death to the world, is alleged to have intimidated her manager and others, which he denies The estate of the late Dolly Parton is involved in a dispute with the country star’s nephew and former head of security, and has filed for a restraining order against him amid allegations of threats. Bryan Seaver was responsible for Parton’s security, and was tasked with announcing her death on 25 August with a video, “something Dolly asked of me years ago”, he said. Continue reading... item.title: Meet Daisha Auda, 15, first Torres Strait Islander to reach The Voice Australia grand final
item.description: Daisha Auda, an inspiring self-taught singer from Logan, Queensland, has carved her name in history on The Voice Australia. She is the first Torres Strait Islander artist to reach the grand final, defying the odds by overcoming elimination in the knockout rounds, where she was saved by another judge. Auda's achievement resonates deeply with First Nations communities, sparking hope in aspiring young artists lacking formal training. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
